_note: Read by quantt/twin/feed.py, where every key is required and range-checked. B10 (team lead 2026-11-25: 'we can trade/interacti with ibrk quotes to run shadow books / test ideas'): the READ-ONLY IBKR market-data feed the trading user writes for the shadow user. Nothing here can send an order; these are pacing and size settings only.
_note_bar_duration: reqHistoricalData durationStr for the daily TRADES bars (useRTH on): IBKR's '<n> <D|W|M|Y>' form. One request per symbol whatever the duration; 6 months covers the 120-day windows the shadow fetchers use (shadow/fetch/yf_px.py --days 120).
_note_request_spacing_s: At least this many seconds between two historical requests, one request open at a time. IBKR's (deprecated) historical-data page lists, for bars of 30 seconds or less, no identical request within 15 s, no six for one contract within 2 s and no more than 60 in any ten minutes, and says the hard limits for '1 mins' and greater were lifted for a 'soft' slow that can end in 'throttling and eventual disconnect' [S: interactivebrokers.github.io/tws-api/historical_limitations.html, read 2026-11-25 through a fetch tool; the current IBKR Campus page refused automated reads]. Daily bars are held to the strict family anyway: 600 s / 60 = 10 s. Each symbol is asked once a run, and runs are hours apart, so no request is ever identical within 15 s. A pacing violation stops the run; nothing is retried.
_note_request_timeout_s: ib_async cancels a historical request that has not answered in this many seconds and returns no bars; the symbol is UNMEASURED for that run.
_note_quote_batch: Intraday quote capture: this many market-data lines open at once, below the default 100 lines (docs/REFERENCES.md 12ib: 50 messages a second at the default 100 lines). Lines are cancelled after each batch.
_note_quote_wait_s: How long each quote batch streams before its values are taken and its lines cancelled. Not measured on this account: the first intraday run measures what arrives in this time.
_note_market_data_type: reqMarketDataType before the quote capture. 3 = delayed: IBKR returns live data instead where the user has it ('If live data is available a request for delayed data would be ignored by TWS') [S: interactivebrokers.github.io/tws-api/market_data_type.html, read 2026-11-25]. Whatever is asked, each value is labelled by the tick type that carried it (quantt/broker/ibkr_market.py), so delayed data cannot be written as live.
_note_max_symbols: Symbols fetched in one run, the books' universes first, then requests. At 10 s spacing, 450 is 75 minutes: the 16:20 run must be off the Gateway before the twin's 17:40 verify window. A symbol over the cap is UNMEASURED and named in the manifest.
_note_requests: Caps on what the shadow user may ask for through <feed>/requests/: files read, distinct requested symbols in total, and bytes per file. Anything over a cap is rejected by name in the manifest, never silently dropped.
_note_max_run_minutes: A run stops at the earlier of this and the twin's next window (quantt/twin/feed.py THE TIMES).
_note_keep_days: Session directories older than this many days are removed by the producer (its own files only).
